title: Simple editor
description: Substack-style minimal block editor: title plus nine allowed blocks. Auto-save with 2s debounce.

documentation.purpose: Substack-style minimal block editor: a title input plus a constrained block tree (paragraph / heading / image / quote / list / list-item / code / separator / embed), with a native document-settings sidebar (Status & visibility, Publish/Schedule, URL/slug, Categories, Tags, Excerpt, Featured image, Author, Discussion). Loads/saves through `core-data` `useEntityRecord('postType', postType, id)`. Auto-saves on a 2-second debounce via the shared `useEntityAutosave` hook (`src/apps/_shared/forms/useEntityAutosave.js`); sidebar panels mutate the same entity through buffered `edit()` so they commit on the same debounce — no extra endpoint. Publish button flips between `Publish` / `Update` (and writes `future` for scheduled dates) based on `record.status`. Composes Gutenberg's `BlockEditorProvider` + `BlockTools` + `WritingFlow` + `ObserveTyping` + `BlockList` directly so the editor renders inline (not iframed) and inherits the shell's DOM. Deliberately content-creation only: NO Block tab / per-block inspector, NO Page Attributes / templates / custom meta / post-format / sticky.

reads.purpose: Resolved post-type entity (`getPostType`) for sidebar panel gating: `supports` (comments / excerpt / thumbnail), `taxonomies` (categories / post_tag), and `capabilities.edit_others_posts` for the Author cap check.

Category checklist + tag token-field options (`useEntityRecords`, view context). Keyed by the taxonomy SLUG (`category` / `post_tag`) — the core-data entity name — NOT the REST base (`categories` / `tags`), which registers no entity and leaves `records` null forever.

Author select options (cap-gated panel). Uses `who=authors` (NOT `capabilities[]=edit_posts`): the `capabilities` REST param requires the admin-only `list_users` cap and 403s for Editors/Authors who can reassign authors, whereas `who=authors` has a relaxed `edit_posts` permission branch. `who` is not deprecated and matches `core:media`.
Featured-image thumbnail preview for the current `featured_media` id.

writes.purpose: Auto-save (`save()` from useEntityRecord, via shared `useEntityAutosave`) every 2s of inactivity while `hasEdits` — but only for draft / auto-draft posts; Publish/Update button flushes immediately for any status. Sidebar panels write `status`, `password`, `date`, `slug`, `author`, `featured_media`, `excerpt`, `comment_status`, `ping_status`, `categories`, `tags` through the same buffered `edit()` → same debounced commit.

Debounced auto-save for pending / published / private / scheduled posts — writes a per-user autosave revision instead of PUTting the live record, mirroring core's autosaves controller (issue #101). The live record is only updated when the author clicks Update.
Create a draft when the route lacks an `id`. Seeds an empty paragraph block in `content` for the same REST 400-on-empty reason as the iframe editor.

states.renders: Centered spinner while core-data resolves the post + block-tree hydrates from `content.raw`.
Toolbar (Back + clean state) + title input + block editor body.
Toolbar shows `Unsaved changes` indicator; auto-save timer running.
Toolbar shows `Saving…`; Publish button is `loading` + disabled.
Toolbar shows `Saved` (live record flushed); auto-fades to `idle` after 2s.

Toolbar shows `Auto-saved` — a per-user autosave revision was written for a pending/published/scheduled post; the live record still has pending edits (`hasEdits` stays true). Auto-fades to `idle` after 2s, then the `with-edits` indicator returns. Only shown when the buffered edits were content fields the autosave persists (`title`/`content`/`excerpt`); if any non-content metadata field is still buffered, the status is suppressed to `idle` so it never reads as 'saved' for a pending metadata change.
Toolbar + empty-state with the error message; no editor body.

interactions.effect: POST a draft with seeded empty paragraph; replace URL via `history.replaceState`; hydrate block tree.
`edit({ title })` on the entity; debounce triggers auto-save.
Focus moves to the first contenteditable in the body (the block list).
`onChange(newBlocks)` updates local block state + serializes back via `edit({ content: serialize(newBlocks) })`; debounce triggers auto-save.

Draft / auto-draft: `save()` PUTs the live record, saveStatus `saving → saved`. Pending / published / private / scheduled: `POST .../autosaves` writes a per-user autosave revision, saveStatus `saving → autosaved`, live record untouched. Both fade after 2s. On failure: `saveStatus = 'error'` with `err.message`.
Cancel any pending auto-save timer, `edit({ status: 'publish' })`, then `save()` synchronously.
Navigate to `#/posts` or `#/pages` based on postType. Dirty-state guard fires if there are unsaved edits.

interactions.trigger: Edit a document-settings panel (visibility / date / slug / categories / tags / excerpt / featured image / author / discussion)
interactions.effect: `edit({ <field>: <value> })` on the same entity; the shared autosave debounce commits it. Featured image opens the core media modal; categories render a checklist; tags a token field; author a cap-gated select.
The plugin's panels render in the same sidebar `<aside>` after the native document-settings Fill — the native panels never monopolize the slot.

a11y.focus-management: Title input gets autofocus via `core:autofocus-target` platform service. Enter/Tab on the title moves focus to the first contenteditable in the body.

keyboard.action: From title input: focus first block.
From title input: focus first block (overrides default newline).

a11y.screen-reader: Save status announces transitions via the visible `Saving…` / `Saved` text; not aria-live (would announce too eagerly during typing).

constraints.note: `registerCoreBlocks()` is gated by a module-level flag + `getBlockTypes().length === 0` check. Calling twice would throw duplicate-registration errors.

Same `

` seed as EditorApp — REST rejects fully-empty posts.

PHP enqueues `wp-block-editor`, `wp-block-library`, `wp-format-library` styles on the shell page so block chrome and default block styles render. A reimplementation must arrange the equivalent style loading.
Block tree is parsed from `record.content.raw` exactly once after first paint (`hydrated` flag). Subsequent records updates do NOT re-parse — that would clobber in-progress edits.
`useDirtyState(regionId, hasEdits, { blocksNavigation: true })` reports unsaved state to the kernel; NavigationGuard shows beforeunload + intra-shell confirm dialogs.
Auto-save uses a single `setTimeout` ref. Publish clears the pending timer + saves immediately to avoid a double-save race.
`editedRecord.title` may be a string (from inline edit) or an object (from REST). The titleValue reader handles both.

The sidebar is content-creation metadata ONLY: Status & visibility, Publish/Schedule, URL/slug, Categories, Tags, Excerpt, Featured image, Author (cap-gated), Discussion. Deliberately NO Block tab / per-block inspector, NO Page Attributes (parent / menu_order / template), NO custom-fields/meta, NO post-format/sticky (issue #119 scope fences). A reimplementation must not reintroduce these — the simple editor stays a writing surface, not a design/structure surface.

The native panels render via `<Fill name="core:editor.sidebar">`, composing with the editor's `<Slot>` of the same name. Plugin fills render alongside (after) the native panels, so the #20 plugin-extension vision is preserved.

The Author panel is gated on `userCan(postType.capabilities.edit_others_posts)` — advisory per spec §8 layer 4 (REST is the authority). `userCan` returns optimistically true for caps not in the pre-computed map; a server 403 on save surfaces inline.

Autosave logic lives in `src/apps/_shared/forms/useEntityAutosave.js` (extracted from this app). It owns the 2s debounce, the draft→parent / published→per-user-revision split (issue #101), the save-status state machine, and `useRestBase` (CPT rest_base derivation, issue #210). The status-routing primitive `autosaveTarget` stays in `autosave.mjs` (pure, unit-tested).

design-system-leakage.purpose: Loading indicator + plugin-extension slot — WPDS 0.12 has no Spinner or Slot port.

design-system-leakage.import: @wordpress/components#Fill, SelectControl, FormToggle, FormTokenField, TextareaControl, BaseControl, CheckboxControl
design-system-leakage.purpose: Document-settings sidebar controls — Fill (slot fill), SelectControl (visibility / author / native optgroup support), FormToggle (discussion toggles), FormTokenField (tags), TextareaControl (excerpt), BaseControl + raw inputs (slug / password / datetime-local), CheckboxControl (categories). All documented WPDS 0.12 @wordpress/components fallbacks.
Collapsible (panel disclosure), Badge (status summary), Stack/Text/Button reused for sidebar layout.
Featured-image picker — opens the core media modal and binds the selection to `featured_media`.
The Gutenberg block-editor primitives. Inline-mounted (not iframed) so block styles inherit from the shell DOM.
Register the ~30 core blocks at first mount (idempotent guard).
Block tree (de)serialization between `record.content.raw` HTML and the React block array.
